name: inferred-alpha-gate
cmd: set -euo pipefail; ROOT=$PWD; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; trap 'find "$OUT" -maxdepth 3 -type d -name .lake -exec rm -rf {} +' EXIT; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bun scripts/gen-lean-library.ts > "$OUT/library-gen.log" 2>&1; cp lean-kernel/library.ts "$OUT/library.ts"; bun scripts/gen-lean-library.ts --check >> "$OUT/library-gen.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.inferred-projection.json > "$OUT/types.log" 2>&1; bun test research/bapa/inferred-projection.test.ts research/bapa/source-projection.test.ts > "$OUT/tests.log" 2>&1; SEED=''; for item in twophase:a562243d6ca33b6a34f6f3225d0228ab7815eb6608b67f3349318c5f5e1ff396 two_phase_commit:11f70b04cbb150d08bff4b3069350baebb83013577ae6c1672b277d56ea9b6fc learning_switch:b7b74efa596b7300767692824fee0eba50f7cd2b3a2844620467eef95c0cb20f learning_switch_i4:a2ba258b5b05c03761289f21e3ea91357deec4382e633c688add5a362d1f7f31; do id=${item%%:*}; sha=${item#*:}; CASE="$OUT/$id"; mkdir "$CASE"; bun research/bapa/proof-emit.ts --projection alpha --capture "capsule-$id" --sha256 "$sha" --out "$CASE/project" > "$CASE/emission.log" 2>&1; if test -n "$SEED"; then cp -a "$SEED/.lake" "$CASE/project/.lake"; fi; cd "$CASE/project"; lake build > "$CASE/lean.log" 2>&1; lake env lean BapaProof.lean >> "$CASE/lean.log" 2>&1; bun "$ROOT/scripts/lean-gate/gate.ts" "$CASE/lean.log" BapaProof.lean > "$CASE/axioms.log" 2>&1; SEED="$CASE/project"; cd "$ROOT"; done; cd "$SEED"; lake env lean "$ROOT/research/bapa/RowAlphaControl.lean" > "$OUT/row-controls.log" 2>&1; bun "$ROOT/scripts/lean-gate/gate.ts" "$OUT/row-controls.log" "$ROOT/research/bapa/RowAlphaControl.lean" > "$OUT/row-axioms.log" 2>&1; cd "$ROOT"; for kind in body capture; do CASE="$OUT/negative-$kind"; mkdir "$CASE"; bun research/bapa/inferred-alpha-control.ts capsule-twophase a562243d6ca33b6a34f6f3225d0228ab7815eb6608b67f3349318c5f5e1ff396 "$kind" "$CASE/project" > "$CASE/emission.log" 2>&1; cp -a "$SEED/.lake" "$CASE/project/.lake"; cd "$CASE/project"; if test "$kind" = body; then if lake build > "$CASE/lean.log" 2>&1; then echo 'unexpected accepted source body drift'; exit 1; fi; bun "$ROOT/research/bapa/inferred-alpha-control.ts" --check-body "$CASE/project" "$CASE/lean.log" > "$CASE/rejection.log" 2>&1; else lake build > "$CASE/lean.log" 2>&1; lake env lean BapaProof.lean >> "$CASE/lean.log" 2>&1; bun "$ROOT/scripts/lean-gate/gate.ts" "$CASE/lean.log" BapaProof.lean > "$CASE/axioms.log" 2>&1; fi; cd "$ROOT"; done; printf '%s\n' 'feat(bapa): transport inferred and counted row binders' > "$OUT/commit-message.txt"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$OUT/commit-message.txt" > "$OUT/commitlint.log" 2>&1
